contentBlocks.text: This week you've chosen a text and a question. Today: build a realistic timeline to actually complete the project!

A realistic capstone timeline breaks a large project into smaller milestones with real target dates, rather than leaving everything until the end — a common cause of rushed, weaker final work. A reasonable structure might be: reading/note-taking (weeks 1-2), drafting an initial analysis (weeks 3-4), revising with evidence (week 5), and final polishing (week 6). Using this structure as a model, write your own four-milestone timeline for your capstone project.
You just built a real project timeline! Tomorrow we'll review everything from this week.

objectives: Understand why breaking a large project into milestones prevents rushed, weaker final work
Write a realistic four-milestone timeline for the child's own capstone project
teacherGuide.facilitationScript:
1. Review this week's capstone-definition, text-choice, and research-question work.
2. Introduce the four-milestone timeline model.
3. Have the child write their own timeline.
4. Complete the worksheet.
5. Preview tomorrow's cumulative review.
differentiationTips: Struggling: use the exact model timeline as a starting template, just filling in real dates rather than designing milestones from scratch
Ready for more: ask the child to identify which milestone they think will be hardest for them personally, and one strategy to stay on track for it
This is a genuinely practical life skill — planning and pacing a long-term independent project is directly useful beyond this course
teacherGuide.answerKey: This is an open-ended planning activity — check that the child's timeline has four genuine, distinct milestones with a logical order (research/reading before drafting, drafting before revising, revising before final polishing) and realistic real-world target dates.
teacherGuide.standardsRationale: Directly addresses this course's capstone-research-project thread, teaching a genuinely practical project-management skill before tomorrow's review.
